name: signalcraft-community-blocks
description: Community blocks for SignalCraft: a notch filter. Also importable as a repository or a NuGet package - use one, not two.
$comment-dependencies: SignalCraft IS required - these blocks derive from core::IBlock and will not
compile without its headers - but it is NOT listed here, and that is
vcpkg's dependency list is what vcpkg must INSTALL FIRST, and SignalCraft is
not a vcpkg port. Listing it makes this port permanently uninstallable:
`vcpkg install` stops with `signalcraft does not exist` and never gets as far
as downloading anything. That was tried; it is the error you get.
Where the requirement IS stated is the CMake config this port installs, which
does find_dependency(SignalCraft CONFIG). A consumer without SignalCraft gets
a clear refusal at configure time, which is the right moment - and anyone
consuming this is building a SignalCraft program, so they already have it on
When SignalCraft ships as a vcpkg port, this gains a real dependencies list
